steps.title: Get your tutorial
steps.body: Your photo becomes a drawing tutorial of 8 or 9 steps, with the original photo alongside.

items.question: What is the Loomis Method?
items.answer: The Loomis Method is a portrait drawing framework that starts with a simplified head shape, then adds center lines, facial landmarks, and proportions so the face can be drawn with structure instead of guesswork.

items.question: What can I learn to draw with Sketch Steps?
items.answer: Portraits and faces, step by step with the Loomis method. On iPhone and iPad, the Animal Drawing style also turns photos of pets and other animals into tutorials. In Tracing Studio you can trace ready-made line drawings of animals, anime, cars, fruits and vegetables, and portraits.

items.question: Is Sketch Steps suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Sketch Steps is made for beginners and hobby artists who want an approachable way to study drawing fundamentals such as proportion, face structure and shading, one step at a time.

items.question: Is the app free?
items.answer: Sketch Steps is free to download on the App Store and Google Play. Creating AI tutorials and Trace AI images requires an active subscription or coins, which are in-app purchases. On iPhone and iPad, the ready-made tutorials are free and need no coins. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

items.question: Which devices does Sketch Steps work on?
items.answer: Sketch Steps is available for iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later on the App Store, and for Android on Google Play. Both versions turn your photos into step-by-step Loomis tutorials and include Trace AI and a tracing studio, but some drawing styles and options differ; the screenshots on this page are from the iPhone app. The iPhone and iPad app is available in 11 languages, and the Android app in 14.

items.question: Can I use my own photos?
items.answer: Yes. Choose a photo from your library or take one with the camera, and crop it before your tutorial is created. Both versions work with portrait photos; on iPhone and iPad you can also use photos of animals. The tutorials are generated by AI, so they can occasionally be imperfect, and results vary from photo to photo.

items.question: How does tracing work?
items.answer: Tracing Studio helps you put a reference on real paper in two ways. With Draw with Camera, you prop your phone above the paper and see the reference over the live camera view. With Draw on Screen, you turn up the brightness and lay paper over the screen. You can trace ready-made templates, your own photos or a Trace AI image, which turns a photo into a reference in a drawing style such as pencil, charcoal or watercolor. The available AI styles differ between iPhone and Android.

items.question: Do I need an account, and what happens to my photos?
items.answer: No account is needed to start. On Android, you sign in with Google only when you buy, restore purchases or choose to sign in from Settings. Photos you upload for AI generation are deleted from our storage within one hour after the request finishes, and no later than seven days after upload. AI Loomis tutorials are kept for 90 days so you can open them again, then deleted. The iOS and Android privacy policies, linked at the bottom of this page, have the details.
